question: Which departments have more than 5 students?
query: SELECT d.name FROM department d JOIN student s ON d.dept_id = s.dept_id GROUP BY d.dept_id HAVING count(*) > 5

question: What is the average GPA of students in Computer Science?
query: SELECT avg(s.gpa) FROM student s JOIN department d ON s.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE d.name = 'Computer Science'

question: List the names of students who are enrolled in Databases.
query: SELECT s.name FROM student s JOIN enrollment e ON s.student_id = e.student_id JOIN course c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.title = 'Databases'

question: Which department has the largest budget?
query: SELECT name FROM department ORDER BY budget DESC LIMIT 1

question: Show each course title and how many students are enrolled in it.
query: SELECT c.title, count(e.student_id) FROM course c LEFT JOIN enrollment e ON c.course_id = e.course_id GROUP BY c.course_id

question: Which students have a GPA higher than the average GPA?
query: SELECT name FROM student WHERE gpa > (SELECT avg(gpa) FROM student)

question: Which courses have no students enrolled?
query: SELECT title FROM course WHERE course_id NOT IN (SELECT course_id FROM enrollment)
